title: YLX final actual variance publication receipt v1
description: Immutable external receipt for the one publisher leaf omitted from an accepted FINAL_ACTUAL_VARIANCE bundle F. After exact approval-bearing F bytes exist, the receipt exact-binds a durable pre-action PASS execution-authorization evaluation E over F and F's selected WBS, records the complete publisher task actual and variance, and proves create-if-absent publication plus file and directory fsync of F's RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 bytes. It grants no planning approval, signoff, release-completion, terminal-slot, or distribution authority; exact readback still requires R.

receipt_id.description: Deterministic ID equal to 'final-actual-variance-publication-' plus lowercase SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 over an object containing exactly final_bundle_ref, final_bundle_sha256, execution_authorization_evaluation_ref, action_instance_id, planned_action_input_sha256, actor_person_id, publisher_task_node_id, publisher_task_actual, and publisher_task_variance from this receipt. Every reference in this preimage has a closed revisioned or unrevisioned shape. Procedural validation recomputes the digest and permits exactly one effective receipt for this preimage.

final_bundle_ref.description: Exact reference to F. Dereferenced bytes must be an accepted delivery-planning-bundle v2 with planning_gate M5, bundle_kind FINAL_ACTUAL_VARIANCE, and the matching closed publisher_closure tuple.

final_bundle_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 bytes published for F. Procedural validation requires equality with final_bundle_ref.artifact_sha256 and the digest segment in final_bundle_locator.

final_bundle_locator.description: Canonical content-addressed target path for F. Procedural validation requires exact equality with final_bundle_ref.artifact_path and requires the embedded digest to equal final_bundle_sha256 and final_bundle_ref.artifact_sha256.

final_bundle_byte_length.description: Byte length of the exact RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 target bytes for F.

execution_authorization_evaluation_ref.description: Exact four-field unrevisioned reference to E. Procedural validation requires a durable pre-action PASS for may_prepare/publish-planning-record created after approval-bearing F exists, with planning_bundle_ref bound to exact F, delivery_wbs_ref bound to F's exact selected WBS, and task_id equal to publisher_task_node_id.

action_instance_id.description: One-shot publication action instance. It must equal the action instance in E.

planned_action_input_sha256.description: Exact planned-action input digest. It must equal the digest in E, whose current planning bundle and WBS are F and F/W.

actor_person_id.description: Natural-person publisher. It must equal the actor in E and the executor selected by F/W for publisher_task_node_id.

publisher_task_node_id.description: Exact publisher_closure.task_node_id from F and E.task_id. F intentionally omits this sole leaf from its task actual and variance maps.

publisher_task_actual.description: Complete terminal actual for the sole publisher leaf omitted from F. It is COMPLETED, has an empty terminal_evidence_refs array because P and R are its external durability evidence, and exact-completes F's non-publisher actual map.

publisher_task_variance.description: Exact planned-versus-actual effort and elapsed variance for publisher_task_node_id. Procedural validation recomputes it from F/W, F's accepted forecast history, and publisher_task_actual.

published_at.description: Completion time of the durable exact create-if-absent publication and required file and parent-directory fsync operations. Procedural validation requires F.generated_at and every F approval before E, E.evaluated_at strictly before publisher_task_actual.actual_started_at, and publisher_task_actual.actual_finished_at exactly equal to published_at.

executionAuthorizationEvaluationRef.description: Exact reference to an immutable unrevisioned execution-authorization evaluation; revision is forbidden.
